∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
      (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
      CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i =

  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
      ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
        (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b) ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
        (OfNat.ofNat 0))

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_global_balan.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i = ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T b
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_global_balan.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b => CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T b)

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mass_balance.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i 0 =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b) 0
      else 0
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mass_balance.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
      ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
        (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b) ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balanc.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i =
    (∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
          CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)
        else 0) +
      ∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then 0
        else CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (T b)
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balanc.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
          (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
          (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (T b))))

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : Fin 3),
  ∑ i, (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)).momentum j =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
              (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b))).momentum
          j
      else CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (m.owner b)) * T b j
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)).momentum j)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
      ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
        ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
              (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b))).momentum
          j)
        (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (m.owner b))) (T b j)))

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_residual_rei.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (m.reindex n e b) γ (fun x => k (b.symm x)) (fun x => V (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (n.symm x)) (fun x => S (e.symm x)) (fun x => T (b.symm x)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_residual_rei.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : Equiv N N') (e : Equiv E E') (b : Equiv B B') (γ : Real)
  (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (m.reindex n e b) γ (fun x => k (DFunLike.coe b.symm x))
      (fun x => V (DFunLike.coe b.symm x)) (fun x => U (DFunLike.coe n.symm x)) (fun x => S (DFunLike.coe e.symm x))
      (fun x => T (DFunLike.coe b.symm x)) (DFunLike.coe n i))
    (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)

CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_compatible.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  (k ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → CFDLean.dot U.momentum T = 0) →
    (k = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → V = U) →
      CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T = (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) T
CFDLean.Boundary.transfer_compatible.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (k : CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  (Ne k CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → Eq (CFDLean.dot U.momentum T) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
    (Eq k CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → Eq V U) →
      Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.transfer γ k U V T) (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) T)

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_add.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (S + T) = CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U S + CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_add.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (HAdd.hAdd S T))
    (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U S) (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T))

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_energy.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T 4 = 0
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_energy.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 0)

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T = CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T) ↔
    CFDLean.dot U.momentum T = 0
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Iff (Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)))
    (Eq (CFDLean.dot U.momentum T) (OfNat.ofNat 0))

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 < U.density →
    T ≠ 0 →
      (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T = CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T) ↔
        CFDLean.dot (fun i => U.momentum i / U.density) (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T) = 0)
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_eq_physical_iff_no.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) U.density →
    Ne T (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      Iff (Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)))
        (Eq (CFDLean.dot (fun i => HDiv.hDiv (U.momentum i) U.density) (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T))
          (OfNat.ofNat 0))

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_mass.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T 0 = 0

∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 0)

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T)).momentum i =
    CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * T i
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T)).momentum i)
    (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U) (T i))

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos.type: ∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3), CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U → 0 < CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_pressure_pos.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U → LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U)

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (-T) = -CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_reverse.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (Neg.neg T)) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T))

CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (a • T) = a • CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_smul.raw_type:
∀ (γ a : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U (HSMul.hSMul a T)) (HSMul.hSMul a (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T))

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_mean_le_wave.type: ∀ (a b : ℝ), |(a + b) / 2| ≤ CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed a b
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.abs_mean_le_wave.raw_type: ∀ (a b : Real), LE.le (abs (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd a b) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed a b)

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cell_entropy_ine.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ),
  0 < dx →
    ∀ (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
      u i * CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i ≤
        -(CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g CFDLean.Burgers.entropyVariable CFDLean.Burgers.entropyPotential
                CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i -
              CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g CFDLean.Burgers.entropyVariable CFDLean.Burgers.entropyPotential
                CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u (g.prev i)) /
          dx
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.cell_entropy_ine.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    ∀ (u : I → Real) (i : I),
      LE.le (HMul.hMul (u i) (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i))
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (Neg.neg
            (HSub.hSub
              (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g CFDLean.Burgers.entropyVariable
                CFDLean.Burgers.entropyPotential CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i)
              (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g CFDLean.Burgers.entropyVariable
                CFDLean.Burgers.entropyPotential CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u (g.prev i))))
          dx)

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.energy_productio.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ),
  0 < dx → ∀ (u : I → ℝ), ∑ i, u i * CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i ≤ 0
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.energy_productio.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    ∀ (u : I → Real),
      LE.le
        (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
          HMul.hMul (u i) (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.numericalFlux u i))
        (OfNat.ofNat 0)

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_iterat.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : ℝ),
  0 < dx →
    0 ≤ dt →
      2 * (dt * max |m| |M|) ≤ dx →
        ∀ u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M,
          ∀ (n : ℕ),
            (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt)^[n] u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M ∧
              CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g ((CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt)^[n] u) ≤
                CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g u
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_iterat.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) dt →
      LE.le (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (HMul.hMul dt (max (abs m) (abs M)))) dx →
        ∀ (u : I → Real),
          Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M) u →
            ∀ (n : Nat),
              And
                (Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M)
                  (Nat.iterate (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt) n u))
                (LE.le
                  (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g
                    (Nat.iterate (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt) n u))
                  (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g u))

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_mem.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : ℝ),
  0 < dx →
    0 ≤ dt →
      2 * (dt * max |m| |M|) ≤ dx →
        ∀ u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M,
          CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_mem.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) dt →
      LE.le (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (HMul.hMul dt (max (abs m) (abs M)))) dx →
        ∀ (u : I → Real),
          Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M) u →
            Membership.mem (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M) (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt u)

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_totalV.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : ℝ),
  0 < dx →
    0 ≤ dt →
      2 * (dt * max |m| |M|) ≤ dx →
        ∀ u ∈ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.boundedStates m M,
          CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep g dx dt u) ≤
            CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g u
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eulerStep_totalV.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx dt m M : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) dx →

              dx * ∑ i, (CFDLean.Euler1D.step γ dx dt U i).momentum 0 = dx * ∑ i, (U i).momentum 0 ∧

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.edge_inciden.type:

  ∑ e, ((if (↑e).1 = a then 1 else 0) - if (↑e).2 = a then 1 else 0) • M.edgeArea e = ∑ b, M.assembledArea a b

          (ite (Eq e.val.2 a) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
        (M.edgeArea e))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b => M.assembledArea a b)

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus.type:
∀ (d : ℕ) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∑ a, T.grad a = 0 ∧
      (∀ (a b c : Fin (d + 1)),
          CFDLean.Num.dot (T.grad a) (T.x b - T.x c) = (if a = b then 1 else 0) - if a = c then 1 else 0) ∧
        ∑ a, CFDLean.Num.outer (T.grad a) (T.x a) = 1 ∧ 0 < T.vol ∧ ∑ o, T.facet o = 0
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus.raw_type:
∀ (d : Nat) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => T.grad a) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
      (And
        (∀ (a b c : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))),
          Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (T.grad a) (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x c)))
            (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq a b) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (ite (Eq a c) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
        (And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => CFDLean.Num.outer (T.grad a) (T.x a)) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
          (And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) T.vol) (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun o => T.facet o) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))))

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.type:
(∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
    T.Nondeg →
      [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
        let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a);
        T.facet o = (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2) else 1 / 2) • nv) ∧
  ∀ (T T' : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c o' a' b' c' : Fin 4),
    T.Nondeg →
      T'.Nondeg →
        [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
          [o', a', b', c'].Nodup →
            T'.x a' = T.x a →
              T'.x b' = T.x b →
                T'.x c' = T.x c →
                  let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a);
                  CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T.x o - T.x a) * CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T'.x o' - T.x a) < 0 →
                    T'.facet o' = -T.facet o
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.raw_type:
And
  (∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
    T.Nondeg →
      (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
        let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a));
        Eq (T.facet o)
          (HSMul.hSMul
            (ite (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Num.dot nv (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
              (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
            nv))
  (∀ (T T' : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c o' a' b' c' : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
    T.Nondeg →
      T'.Nondeg →
        (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
          (List.cons o' (List.cons a' (List.cons b' (List.cons c' List.nil)))).Nodup →
            Eq (T'.x a') (T.x a) →
              Eq (T'.x b') (T.x b) →
                Eq (T'.x c') (T.x c) →
                  let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a));
                  LT.lt
                      (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.dot nv (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a)))
                        (CFDLean.Num.dot nv (HSub.hSub (T'.x o') (T.x a))))
                      (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
                    Eq (T'.facet o') (Neg.neg (T.facet o)))

∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2) (o a b : Fin 3),

      T.facet o =

∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (o a b : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),

            (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
          (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a))))

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.median_defect_iff.type:

        ((∀ (a b : Fin (d + 1)), a ≠ b → δ a • T.grad b + δ b • T.grad a = 0) ↔ ∀ (a : Fin (d + 1)), δ a = 0)
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.median_defect_iff.raw_type:
∀ (d : Nat) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (δ : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → Real),

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    M.Closed i →
      ∑ k, ((1 / 2) • (F i + F k)).mulVec (M.n i k) = ∑ k, (F k).mulVec (M.c i k) ∧
        ∑ k, (F k).mulVec (M.c i k) =
          ∑ T, ∑ a, if (M.vert T) a = i then (M.ω T * M.m T) • ∑ b, (F ((M.vert T) b)).mulVec (M.g T b) else 0
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.raw_type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : Nat)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    M.Closed i →
      And
        (Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
            (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd (F i) (F k))).mulVec (M.n i k))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k => (F k).mulVec (M.c i k)))
        (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => (F k).mulVec (M.c i k))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
              ite (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i)
                (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (M.ω T) (M.m T))
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun b => (F (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b)).mulVec (M.g T b)))
                (OfNat.ofNat 0)))

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (i : ι), M.beta i = ∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then (1 / ↑d) • M.areaVec p else 0) ∧
          (∀ (i k : ι),
              M.B i k =
                ∑ p,
                  if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
                    ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
                  else 0) ∧
            ∀ (i : ι), (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)), bd p = true → i ∉ M.facetNodes p) → M.Closed i
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        And
          (∀ (i : ι),
            Eq (M.beta i)
              (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
                ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast) (M.areaVec p)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
          (And
            (∀ (i k : ι),
              Eq (M.B i k)
                (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
                  ite
                    (And (Eq (bd p) true) (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)))
                    (HSMul.hSMul
                      (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                        (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                      (M.areaVec p))
                    (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
            (∀ (i : ι),
              (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                  Eq (bd p) true → Not (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i)) →
                M.Closed i))

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → (M.Gtensor M.nu i).trace = 2 * ↑d * M.V i) ∧
      ∑ i, ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = 2 * ↑d * M.volΩ ∧
        (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → 2 * ↑d * M.V i ≤ (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace) ∧
          ∀ (i : ι),
            M.Closed i → ((M.Gtensor M.n i).trace = 2 * ↑d * M.V i ↔ ∀ (k : ι), ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ M.n i k = t • M.e i k)
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    And (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → Eq (M.Gtensor M.nu i).trace (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) (M.V i)))
      (And
        (Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun k => HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)))
          (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) M.volΩ))
        (And
          (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → LE.le (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) (M.V i)) (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace)
          (∀ (i : ι),
            M.Closed i →
              Iff (Eq (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) (M.V i)))
                (∀ (k : ι), Exists fun t => And (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) t) (Eq (M.n i k) (HSMul.hSMul t (M.e i k)))))))

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i k : ι), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = 2 * M.mu i k) ∧
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        i ≠ k →
          (∃ T a b, (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k ∧ 0 < M.ω T) →
            0 < M.mu i k ∧
              (∃ t, 0 < t ∧ M.nu i k = t • M.e i k) ∧
                CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) = CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) / CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    And (∀ (i k : ι), Ne i k → Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (M.mu i k)))
      (∀ (i k : ι),
        Ne i k →
          (Exists fun T =>
              Exists fun a =>
                Exists fun b =>
                  And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i)
                    (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k) (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.ω T)))) →
            And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.mu i k))
              (And (Exists fun t => And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) t) (Eq (M.nu i k) (HSMul.hSMul t (M.e i k))))
                (Eq (CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k))))))

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_outer.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i : ι), ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.outer (M.c i k) (M.e i k) = M.V i • 1) ∧
      (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.outer (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = (2 * M.V i) • 1) ∧
        ∑ i, ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.outer (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = (2 * M.volΩ) • 1 ∧ ∑ i, M.V i = M.volΩ
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_outer.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    And
      (∀ (i : ι),
        Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => CFDLean.Num.outer (M.c i k) (M.e i k)) (HSMul.hSMul (M.V i) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
      (And
        (∀ (i : ι),
          M.Closed i →
            Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => CFDLean.Num.outer (M.n i k) (M.e i k))
              (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (M.V i)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
        (And
          (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => Finset.univ.sum fun k => CFDLean.Num.outer (M.n i k) (M.e i k))
            (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) M.volΩ) (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
          (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => M.V i) M.volΩ)))

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissTensor_trace.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (σ : ι → ι → ℝ) (s σmax h : ℝ) (y : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    0 < M.V i →
      let K := fun z =>
        (1 / (4 * M.V i)) • ∑ k, (σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (z i k)) • CFDLean.Num.outer (M.e i k) (M.e i k);
      ((∀ (k : ι), k ≠ i → σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = s) → K y = (s / (4 * M.V i)) • M.Gtensor y i) ∧
        ((∀ (k : ι), k ≠ i → σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = s) → (K M.nu).trace = ↑d * s / 2) ∧
          ((∀ (k : ι), 0 ≤ σ i k ∧ σ i k ≤ σmax) →
            (∀ (k : ι), M.n i k ≠ 0 → CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) ≤ h) → (K M.nu).trace ≤ ↑d / 2 * σmax * h)
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissTensor_trace.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (σ : ι → ι → Real) (s σmax h : Real) (y : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.V i) →
      let K := fun z =>
        HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) (M.V i)))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
            HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (σ i k) (CFDLean.Num.len (z i k))) (CFDLean.Num.outer (M.e i k) (M.e i k)));
      And
        ((∀ (k : ι), Ne k i → Eq (HMul.hMul (σ i k) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k))) s) →
          Eq (K y) (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv s (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) (M.V i))) (M.Gtensor y i)))
        (And
          ((∀ (k : ι), Ne k i → Eq (HMul.hMul (σ i k) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k))) s) →
            Eq (K M.nu).trace (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul d.cast s) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          ((∀ (k : ι), And (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (σ i k)) (LE.le (σ i k) σmax)) →
            (∀ (k : ι), Ne (M.n i k) (OfNat.ofNat 0) → LE.le (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)) h) →
              LE.le (K M.nu).trace (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 2)) σmax) h)))

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.faceRule_beta_B.type:
∀ (ι C Q : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [inst_2 : DecidableEq C] [inst_3 : Fintype Q]
  (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool) (fq : Q → C × Fin (d + 1)) (aq : Q → ℝ)
  (φ : Q → ι → ℝ),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), bd (fq q) = true) →
          (∀ (q : Q), ∀ k ∉ M.facetNodes (fq q), φ q k = 0) →
            (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
                bd p = true → ∀ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, (∑ q, if fq q = p then aq q * φ q i else 0) = 1 / ↑d) →
              (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
                  bd p = true →
                    ∀ i ∈ M.facetNodes p,
                      ∀ k ∈ M.facetNodes p,
                        (∑ q, if fq q = p then aq q * φ q i * φ q k else 0) =
                          (1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) →
                let N := fun q => aq q • M.areaVec (fq q);
                (∀ (i : ι), ∑ q, φ q i • N q = M.beta i) ∧ ∀ (i k : ι), ∑ q, (φ q i * φ q k) • N q = M.B i k
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.faceRule_beta_B.raw_type:
∀ (ι C Q : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] [inst_2 : DecidableEq C] [inst_3 : Fintype Q]
  (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool)
  (fq : Q → Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))) (aq : Q → Real) (φ : Q → ι → Real),
  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), Eq (bd (fq q)) true) →
          (∀ (q : Q) (k : ι), Not (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes (fq q)) k) → Eq (φ q k) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
            (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                Eq (bd p) true →
                  ∀ (i : ι),
                    Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i →
                      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => ite (Eq (fq q) p) (HMul.hMul (aq q) (φ q i)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
                        (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast)) →
              (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                  Eq (bd p) true →
                    ∀ (i : ι),
                      Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i →
                        ∀ (k : ι),
                          Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k →
                            Eq
                              (Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
                                ite (Eq (fq q) p) (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (aq q) (φ q i)) (φ q k)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
                              (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                                (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))) →
                let N := fun q => HSMul.hSMul (aq q) (M.areaVec (fq q));
                And (∀ (i : ι), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (φ q i) (N q)) (M.beta i))

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entrop.type:

  (Fs : C × Fin (d + 1) → ι → κ → ℝ),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        let b := fun i =>
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then ∑ j ∈ M.facetNodes p, CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j • Fs p j else 0;
        ∑ i, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.beta i) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (b i)) =
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true then
              1 / ↑d * ∑ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.areaVec p) - CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (Fs p i)) +
                1 / (4 * ↑d * (↑d + 1)) *
                  ∑ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, ∑ j ∈ M.facetNodes p, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w j - w i) (Fs p j - Fs p i)
            else 0
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_entrop.raw_type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : Fintype κ] (d : Nat)

              ((M.facetNodes p).sum fun j => HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j) (Fs p j)) (OfNat.ofNat 0);
        Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.beta i)) (CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (b i)))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
            ite (Eq (bd p) true)

                  ((M.facetNodes p).sum fun i =>
                    HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.dot (ψ i) (M.areaVec p)) (CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (Fs p i))))
                (HMul.hMul
                  (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) d.cast) (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                  ((M.facetNodes p).sum fun i =>
                    (M.facetNodes p).sum fun j =>
                      CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub (w j) (w i)) (HSub.hSub (Fs p j) (Fs p i)))))
              (OfNat.ofNat 0))

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.standardClosure_linear.raw_type:

CFDLean.Num.dissTensor_loewner.type:
∀ (ι : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : ℕ) (e y : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (σ : ι → ℝ) (V : ℝ),
  0 < V →
    (∀ (k : ι), 0 ≤ σ k) →
      (∀ (k : ι), 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)) →
        let K := fun z => (1 / (4 * V)) • ∑ k, (σ k * CFDLean.Num.len (z k)) • CFDLean.Num.outer (e k) (e k);
        let ν := fun k => CFDLean.Num.WMesh.nuOf (y k) (e k);
        (∀ (k : ι),
            CFDLean.Num.len (y k) =
                CFDLean.Num.len (ν k) * (CFDLean.Num.len (y k) * CFDLean.Num.len (e k) / CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)) ∧
              1 ≤ CFDLean.Num.len (y k) * CFDLean.Num.len (e k) / CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)) ∧
          (K y - K ν).PosSemidef ∧ (K y = K ν ↔ ∀ (k : ι), 0 < σ k → ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ y k = t • e k)
CFDLean.Num.dissTensor_loewner.raw_type:
∀ (ι : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] (d : Nat) (e y : ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (σ : ι → Real) (V : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) V →
    (∀ (k : ι), LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (σ k)) →
      (∀ (k : ι), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k))) →
        let K := fun z =>
          HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) V))
            (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
              HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (σ k) (CFDLean.Num.len (z k))) (CFDLean.Num.outer (e k) (e k)));
        let ν := fun k => CFDLean.Num.WMesh.nuOf (y k) (e k);
        And
          (∀ (k : ι),
            And
              (Eq (CFDLean.Num.len (y k))
                (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (ν k))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (y k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (e k)))
                    (CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)))))
              (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (y k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (e k))) (CFDLean.Num.dot (y k) (e k)))))
          (And (HSub.hSub (K y) (K ν)).PosSemidef
            (Iff (Eq (K y) (K ν))
              (∀ (k : ι),
                LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (σ k) →
                  Exists fun t => And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) t) (Eq (y k) (HSMul.hSMul t (e k))))))

          (∀ (i k : ι), eps2 k i = eps2 i k) →
            (∀ (i k : ι), eps4 k i = eps4 i k) →
              let L := fun i => ∑ k ∈ Nstar i, (ut k - ut i);

                Fec (u i) (u k) (n i k) + lam i k • (eps2 i k • (ut i - ut k) - eps4 i k • (L i - L k));

CFDLean.Num.dissipativePairFlux_conserva.raw_type:
∀ (ι S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] (d : Nat) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → Real)
  (n : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (u : ι → S) (ut : ι → κ → Real) (lam eps2 eps4 : ι → ι → Real) (Nstar : ι → Finset ι)

                  (HSMul.hSMul (lam i k)
                    (HSub.hSub (HSMul.hSMul (eps2 i k) (HSub.hSub (ut i) (ut k)))
                      (HSMul.hSMul (eps4 i k) (HSub.hSub (L i) (L k)))));
              And (∀ (i k : ι), Eq (F k i) (Neg.neg (F i k)))

CFDLean.Num.dissipativePairFlux_freeStre.raw_type:
∀ (ι S κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] (d : Nat) (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → Real)
  (phys : S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → Real) (n : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (U : S) (ut0 : κ → Real)
  (lam eps2 eps4 : ι → ι → Real) (Nstar : ι → Finset ι),
  (∀ (a b : S), IsLinearMap Real (Fec a b)) →
    (∀ (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Eq (Fec U U y) (phys U y)) →
      let beta := fun i => Neg.neg (Finset.univ.sum fun k => n i k);
      let L := fun i => (Nstar i).sum fun _k => HSub.hSub ut0 ut0;
      let F := fun i k =>

  (Fec : S → S → CFDLean.Num.Vec d → κ → Real) (Fl : S → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real) (u : ι → S) (φ : Q → ι → Real)
  (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (ut : Q → S),
  (∀ (a b : S) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
      Eq (Fec a b y) ((HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd (Fl a) (Fl b))).mulVec y)) →
    (∀ (q : Q), Eq (Fl (ut q)) (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSMul.hSMul (φ q k) (Fl (u k)))) →
      (∀ (q : Q), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => φ q k) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) →
        let beta := fun i => Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (φ q i) (N q);
        let b := fun i =>
          Finset.univ.sum fun q =>
            HSMul.hSMul (φ q i)
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HSub.hSub (Fec (u i) (ut q) (N q))
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSMul.hSMul (φ q k) (Fec (ut q) (u k) (N q))))
                ((Fl (ut q)).mulVec (N q)));
        ∀ (i : ι),
          Eq (b i)
            (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
              (HAdd.hAdd ((Fl (u i)).mulVec (beta i))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
                  (Fl (u k)).mulVec (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (φ q i) (φ q k)) (N q)))))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (bas : Module.Basis ι ℝ CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → ℝ),
            (∀ (i : ι), (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (bas i) = μ i • bas i) →
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n =
                ↑bas.equivFun.symm ∘ₗ (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => |μ i|) ∘ₗ ↑bas.equivFun
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_basis.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (bas : Module.Basis ι Real CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (μ : ι → Real),
            (∀ (i : ι),
                Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (DFunLike.coe bas i))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (μ i) (DFunLike.coe bas i))) →
              Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n)
                (bas.equivFun.symm.comp
                  ((CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.diagonal fun i => abs (μ i)).comp bas.equivFun.toLinearMap))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),

    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (μ : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_absolute_eigen.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),

            Ne v (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
              Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) v) (HSMul.hSMul μ v) →
                Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n) v) (HSMul.hSMul (abs μ) v)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),

      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∃ bas,
            ∀ (j : Fin 5),
              ∃ i, (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (bas j) = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i • bas j
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_complete_basis.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tang.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
      ∀ (tb : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n)),
        Submodule.span ℝ
            ({CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)} ∪
              Set.range fun i => CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) ↑(tb i)) =
          Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_convective_tang.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
      ∀
        (tb :
          Module.Basis (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 2)) Real (Subtype fun x => Membership.mem (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n) x)),
        Eq
          (Submodule.span Real
            (max (singleton (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)))
              (Set.range fun i =>
                CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (DFunLike.coe tb i).val)))
          (Module.End.eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap
            (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n ^ 3 =
            CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ^ 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_cubic.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),

            (HSMul.hSMul (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
              (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 3),
            Module.finrank ℝ
                ↥(Module.End.eigenspace (↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i)) =
              ![1, 3, 1] i
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_dimensions.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          ∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
            Eq
              (Module.finrank Real
                (Subtype fun x_1 =>
                  Membership.mem
                    (Module.End.eigenspace (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap
                      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i))
                    x_1))
              (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 3) (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1) Matrix.vecEmpty)) i)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          (∀ (s : ℝ),
              s = -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ∨ s = CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y →
                (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) =
                  (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n + s) •
                    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) ∧
            (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)) =
                CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n •
                  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) ∧
              ∀ (t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
                CFDLean.dot t n = 0 →
                  (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t) =
                    CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n •
                      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
          And
            (∀ (s : Real),
              Or (Eq s (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y))) (Eq s (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y)) →
                Eq
                  (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n) s)
                    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s)))
            (And
              (Eq
                (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)))
                (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n)
                  (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y))))
              (∀ (t : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
                Eq (CFDLean.dot t n) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
                  Eq
                    (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t))
                    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n)
                      (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.shear (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) t))))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 0 + CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 1 +
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 2 =
          1
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_projector_sum.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
              (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
            (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (OfNat.ofNat 1)

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_shift_reverse.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y (Neg.neg n)) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomp.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        ↑(CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) =
          CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 0 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 0 +
              CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 1 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 1 +
            CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n 2 • CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n 2
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_spectral_decomp.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Eq (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n).toLinearMap
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
                (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
            (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
              (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y (-n) i = -CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i.rev
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_speed_reverse.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y (Neg.neg n) i) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeSpeed γ x y n i.rev))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ y x n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin 3), CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ y x n i = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i) ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ y x n = CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_swap.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  And (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ y x n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeShift γ x y n))
    (And
      (∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
        Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ y x n i) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roeProjector γ x y n i))
      (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ y x n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation γ x y n)))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        0 < CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ∧
          CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ^ 2 =
            (γ - 1) * (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y - CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) / 2)
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.sound_parameters.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y))
          (Eq (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
            (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
              (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))

CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent_dimension.type: ∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot n n = 1 → Module.finrank ℝ ↥(CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n) = 2
CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent_dimension.raw_type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq (Module.finrank Real (Subtype fun x => Membership.mem (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.tangent n) x)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)

    CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ y x = CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ y x = CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y
CFDLean.Roe.averages_swap.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  And (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity y x) (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y))
    (And (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ y x) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y))
      (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ y x) (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y)))

CFDLean.Roe.flux_midpoint_jump.type:

  CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux γ n t - CFDLean.Roe.parameterFlux γ n z =
    (CFDLean.Roe.C γ n fun i => (z i + t i) / 2) (t - z)
CFDLean.Roe.flux_midpoint_jump.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (z t : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

    (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.C γ n fun i => HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (z i) (t i)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HSub.hSub t z))

CFDLean.Roe.hasFDerivAt_parameterState.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

CFDLean.Roe.integrated_secant.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        S ≠ 0 →
          (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S • CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) (y - x) =
            CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y - CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x
CFDLean.Roe.integrated_secant.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        Ne S (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
          Eq
            (DFunLike.coe
              (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S)
                (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)))
              (HSub.hSub y x))
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S y) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.coordinateFlux γ S x))

∀ (γ : Real) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

      ∀ (v : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
        Eq (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.inverseB γ z) (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Roe.B γ z) v)) v

  CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ V U (-S) =
    { density := -(CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).density,
      momentum := fun i => -(CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).momentum i,
      energy := -(CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).energy }
CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_reverse.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),

    { density := Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).density,

CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_scale.type:
∀ (γ a : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  0 ≤ a →
    (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V fun i => a * S i) =
      { density := a * (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).density,
        momentum := fun i => a * (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).momentum i,
        energy := a * (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).energy }

∀ (γ a : Real) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) a →
    Eq (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V fun i => HMul.hMul a (S i))
      { density := HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).density,
        momentum := fun i => HMul.hMul a ((CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).momentum i),
        energy := HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S).energy }

CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_upwind_left.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        S ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V) ≤
              CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S) →
            CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S = CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S
CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_upwind_left.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        Ne S (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
          LE.le (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
              (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S)) →
            Eq (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S) (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S)

CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_upwind_right.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        S ≠ 0 →
          CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S) ≤
              -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V) →
            CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S = CFDLean.physicalFlux γ V S
CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_upwind_right.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ V →
        Ne S (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
          LE.le
              (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))
                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal S))
              (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode V))) →
            Eq (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V S) (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ V S)

CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux_zero.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U V : CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ U V 0 = { density := 0, momentum := fun x => 0, energy := 0 }

CFDLean.Roe.operator_B.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  γ ≠ 0 →
    z 0 ≠ 0 →
      CFDLean.Roe.operator γ (fun i => z ↑↑i.succ / z 0) (z 4 / z 0) n ∘SL CFDLean.Roe.B γ z = CFDLean.Roe.C γ n z
CFDLean.Roe.operator_B.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (z : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),

        ((CFDLean.Roe.operator γ (fun i => HDiv.hDiv (z i.succ.val.cast) (z ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HDiv.hDiv (z ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (z ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)) n).comp
          (CFDLean.Roe.B γ z))
        (CFDLean.Roe.C γ n z)

CFDLean.Roe.positivity_counterexample.type:
CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible 2 CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft ∧
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible 2 CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight ∧
    0 <
        CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare 2 (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)
          (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight) ∧
      CFDLean.Roe.witnessIntermediate.density < 0

And (CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)

    (And
      (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
        (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare (OfNat.ofNat 2) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessLeft)
          (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode CFDLean.Roe.witnessRight)))
      (LT.lt CFDLean.Roe.witnessIntermediate.density (OfNat.ofNat 0))))

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_B.type:

CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix_B.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Ne γ (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (y ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →

CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  0 < x 0 →
    0 < y 0 →
      CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y =
        CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ x +
            CFDLean.Roe.weight y x * CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ y +
          (γ - 1) / 2 * CFDLean.Roe.weight x y * CFDLean.Roe.weight y x *
            CFDLean.squareSum fun i => CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i - CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i
CFDLean.Roe.variance_identity.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (x y : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (y ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) →
      Eq (CFDLean.Roe.soundSquare γ x y)
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Roe.weight x y) (CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ x))
            (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Roe.weight y x) (CFDLean.Roe.endpointSoundSquare γ y)))
          (HMul.hMul
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (CFDLean.Roe.weight x y))
              (CFDLean.Roe.weight y x))
            (CFDLean.squareSum fun i =>
              HSub.hSub (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity y i) (CFDLean.PhysicalJacobian.velocity x i))))

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ) (v ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux),
  CFDLean.Scalar.EntropyConservative v ψ nf →
    ∀ (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),
      v (u i) * CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx nf u i =
        -(CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i -
              CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u (g.prev i)) /
          dx
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : Real) (v ψ : Real → Real) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux),
  CFDLean.Scalar.EntropyConservative v ψ nf →
    ∀ (u : I → Real) (i : I),
      Eq (HMul.hMul (v (u i)) (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx nf u i))
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (Neg.neg
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i)
              (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u (g.prev i))))
          dx)

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ) (v ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux) (u : I → ℝ)
  (i : I),
  v (u i) * CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx nf u i +
      (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i -
          CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u (g.prev i)) /
        dx =
    ((v (u (g.next i)) - v (u i)) * nf.eval (u i) (u (g.next i)) - (ψ (u (g.next i)) - ψ (u i)) +
        ((v (u i) - v (u (g.prev i))) * nf.eval (u (g.prev i)) (u i) - (ψ (u i) - ψ (u (g.prev i))))) /
      (2 * dx)
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : Real) (v ψ : Real → Real) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux)
  (u : I → Real) (i : I),
  Eq
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (v (u i)) (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.rhs g dx nf u i))
      (HDiv.hDiv
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u i)
          (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.entropyFlux g v ψ nf u (g.prev i)))
        dx))
    (HDiv.hDiv
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HSub.hSub
          (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub (v (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i))) (v (u i))) (nf.eval (u i) (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i))))
          (HSub.hSub (ψ (u (DFunLike.coe g.next i))) (ψ (u i))))
        (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub (v (u i)) (v (u (g.prev i)))) (nf.eval (u (g.prev i)) (u i)))
          (HSub.hSub (ψ (u i)) (ψ (u (g.prev i))))))
      (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) dx))

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.cell_entropy.type:
∀ {I : Type u_2} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (dx : ℝ),

    ∀ (v ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (nf : CFDLean.Scalar.NumericalFlux),
      CFDLean.Scalar.EntropyStable v ψ nf →
        ∀ (u : I → ℝ) (i : I),

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalU.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (C D u : I → ℝ) (m M : ℝ) (i : I),
  0 ≤ C i →
    0 ≤ D (g.prev i) →
      C i + D (g.prev i) ≤ 1 →
        (∀ (j : I), m ≤ u j) →
          (∀ (j : I), u j ≤ M) →
            m ≤ CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u i ∧
              CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u i ≤ M

  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (C i) →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (D (g.prev i)) →
      LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (C i) (D (g.prev i))) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
        (∀ (j : I), LE.le m (u j)) →
          (∀ (j : I), LE.le (u j) M) →
            And (LE.le m (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u i))
              (LE.le (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u i) M)

CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalU.type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (C D u : I → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : I), 0 ≤ C i) →
    (∀ (i : I), 0 ≤ D i) →
      (∀ (i : I), C i + D i ≤ 1) →
        CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g (CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalUpdate g C D u) ≤
          CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.totalVariation g u
CFDLean.Scalar.FiniteVolume.incrementalU.raw_type:
∀ {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (g : CFDLean.Periodic.Grid I) (C D u : I → Real),

  CFDLean.Time.SSP.ssprk2 (CFDLean.Time.ForwardEuler.step dt L) u i =

  v ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (R : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3),
      v • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Time.euler v τ R U) = v • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U - τ • R

      Eq (HSMul.hSMul v (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Time.euler v τ R U)))
        (HSub.hSub (HSMul.hSMul v (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U)) (HSMul.hSMul τ R))

    (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U) (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv τ v) R))

  CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
    CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U - ∑ i, τ i • CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i

∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (τ : Fin n → Real)
  (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U))
    (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U)
      (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HSMul.hSMul (τ i) (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)))

CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → τ i = dt) →
    CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
      CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U - dt • ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b

∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (τ : Fin n → Real)
  (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (dt : Real),

    Eq (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U))
      (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U)
        (HSMul.hSMul dt (Finset.univ.sum fun b => CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b)))

CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance_physica.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ),
  1 < γ →
    ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ)
      (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
      0 ≤ dt →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (U i)) →
          (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
              CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b)) →
            (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → τ i = dt) →
              CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
                CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U - dt • ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b
CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_balance_physica.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
      (τ : Fin n → Real) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (dt : Real),
      LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) dt →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (U i)) →
          (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
              Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b)) →
            (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → Eq (τ i) dt) →
              Eq (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U))
                (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U)
                  (HSMul.hSMul dt (Finset.univ.sum fun b => CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b)))

CFDLean.Time.mesh_common_state.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ),
      1 < γ →
        ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → 0 ≤ τ i) →
            ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3),
              CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                      CFDLean.dot U.momentum (M.boundaryArea b) = 0) →
                  (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                      CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                        CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b = U) →
                    ∀ (i : Fin n), CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ (fun x => U) i = U

∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : Real),
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
        ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
          (τ : Fin n → Real),
          (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (τ i)) →
            ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
              CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    Ne (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                      Eq (CFDLean.dot U.momentum (M.boundaryArea b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
                  (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                      Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                        Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) U) →
                    ∀ (i : Fin n), Eq (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ (fun x => U) i) U

CFDLean.Time.mesh_component_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ) (j : Fin 5),
  ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i) j =
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i) j - dt * ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b j
