∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (dt : Real) (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 5)),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
      HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i) j))
    (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i) j))
      (HMul.hMul dt (Finset.univ.sum fun b => CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b j)))

CFDLean.Time.mesh_energy_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
  ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).energy =
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (U i).energy -
      dt *
        ∑ b,
          if CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
            CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
              (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b) 4
          else 0
CFDLean.Time.mesh_energy_balance.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (dt : Real),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).energy)
    (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) (U i).energy)
      (HMul.hMul dt
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
            (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
              (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b) ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
            (OfNat.ofNat 0))))

CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
    CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U -
      (∑ e,
          (τ (M.interfaces.tail e) - τ (M.interfaces.head e)) •
            CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea e +
        ∑ b, τ (M.interfaces.owner b) • CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b)
CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (τ : Fin n → Real)
  (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U))
    (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U)
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
          HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub (τ (M.interfaces.tail e)) (τ (M.interfaces.head e)))
            (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea e))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b => HSMul.hSMul (τ (M.interfaces.owner b)) (CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b))))

CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance_physical.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ),
  1 < γ →
    ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → 0 ≤ τ i) →
        ∀ (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
          (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (U i)) →
            (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b)) →
              CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U) =
                CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U -
                  (∑ e,
                      (τ (M.interfaces.tail e) - τ (M.interfaces.head e)) •
                        CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea e +
                    ∑ b, τ (M.interfaces.owner b) • CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b)
CFDLean.Time.mesh_local_balance_physical.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
      (τ : Fin n → Real),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (τ i)) →
        ∀ (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
          (∀ (i : Fin n), M.Used i → CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (U i)) →
            (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b)) →
              Eq (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U))
                (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Time.amount M.dualVolume U)
                  (HAdd.hAdd
                    (Finset.univ.sum fun e =>
                      HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub (τ (M.interfaces.tail e)) (τ (M.interfaces.head e)))
                        (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea e))
                    (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
                      HSMul.hSMul (τ (M.interfaces.owner b)) (CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b))))

  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ),
  ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).density =
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (U i).density -

CFDLean.Time.mesh_mass_balance.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (dt : Real),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).density)
    (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) (U i).density)
      (HMul.hMul dt
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
            (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))

CFDLean.Time.mesh_momentum_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (dt : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
  ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).momentum j =
    ∑ i, M.dualVolume i * (U i).momentum j -
      dt *
        ∑ b,
          if CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
            (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
                  (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
                    (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b))).momentum
              j
          else CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b)) * M.boundaryArea b j
CFDLean.Time.mesh_momentum_balance.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (dt : Real) (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) ((CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V (fun x => dt) U i).momentum j))
    (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (M.dualVolume i) ((U i).momentum j))
      (HMul.hMul dt
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
            ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
                  (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))
                    (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) (M.boundaryArea b))).momentum
              j)
            (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (M.interfaces.owner b))) (M.boundaryArea b j)))))

CFDLean.Time.mesh_point_amount.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  M.Used i →
    M.dualVolume i • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i) =
      M.dualVolume i • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i) - τ i • CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i
CFDLean.Time.mesh_point_amount.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (τ : Fin n → Real)

        (HSMul.hSMul (τ i) (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)))

CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_reindex.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Fin n ≃ N') (e : M.Edge ≃ E')
  (b : M.Boundary ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Time.heldStep (fun x => M.Used (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.dualVolume (nodeEq.symm x))
      (fun x => τ (nodeEq.symm x))
      (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (b.symm x)) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (b.symm x))
        (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.edgeArea (e.symm x)) fun x => M.boundaryArea (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (nodeEq i) =
    CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i
CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_reindex.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Equiv (Fin n) N') (e : Equiv M.Edge E')
  (b : Equiv M.Boundary B') (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (τ : Fin n → Real)
  (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin n),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.Time.heldStep (fun x => M.Used (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x))
      (fun x => M.dualVolume (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => τ (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x))
      (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (DFunLike.coe b.symm x))
        (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (DFunLike.coe b.symm x)) (fun x => U (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x))
        (fun x => M.edgeArea (DFunLike.coe e.symm x)) fun x => M.boundaryArea (DFunLike.coe b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x)) (DFunLike.coe nodeEq i))
    (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i)

CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (τ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  M.Used i →
    CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i =
      CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i) - (τ i / M.dualVolume i) • CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)
CFDLean.Time.mesh_step_used.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (τ : Fin n → Real)
  (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin n),
  M.Used i →
    Eq (CFDLean.Time.meshStep M γ k V τ U i)
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (U i))
          (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (τ i) (M.dualVolume i)) (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i))))

CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (τ : N → ℝ)
  (f : E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  ∑ i, τ i • CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i = ∑ e, (τ (m.tail e) - τ (m.head e)) • f e + ∑ b, τ (m.owner b) • g b
CFDLean.Time.weighted_residual.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (τ : N → Real)
  (f : E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HSMul.hSMul (τ i) (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i))
    (HAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun e => HSMul.hSMul (HSub.hSub (τ (m.tail e)) (τ (m.head e))) (f e))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b => HSMul.hSMul (τ (m.owner b)) (g b)))

CFDLean.admissible_exists.raw_type: ∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ → Exists fun U => CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U

CFDLean.admissible_iff_internalEnergy_po.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  1 < γ →
    (CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U ↔ 0 < U.density ∧ CFDLean.squareSum U.momentum / (2 * U.density) < U.energy)
CFDLean.admissible_iff_internalEnergy_po.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    Iff (CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U)
      (And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) U.density)
        (LT.lt (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum U.momentum) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) U.density)) U.energy))

CFDLean.conservative_admissible_toPrimit.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U → (CFDLean.Conservative.toPrimitive γ U).Admissible
CFDLean.conservative_admissible_toPrimit.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U → (CFDLean.Conservative.toPrimitive γ U).Admissible

CFDLean.conservative_roundTrip.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  γ ≠ 1 → U.density ≠ 0 → CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ (CFDLean.Conservative.toPrimitive γ U) = U
CFDLean.conservative_roundTrip.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  Ne γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Ne U.density (OfNat.ofNat 0) → Eq (CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ (CFDLean.Conservative.toPrimitive γ U)) U

CFDLean.dot_add.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (v S T : CFDLean.Vector d), (CFDLean.dot v fun i => S i + T i) = CFDLean.dot v S + CFDLean.dot v T
CFDLean.dot_add.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (v S T : CFDLean.Vector d),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot v fun i => HAdd.hAdd (S i) (T i)) (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.dot v S) (CFDLean.dot v T))

CFDLean.dot_mul.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (v S : CFDLean.Vector d) (a : ℝ), (CFDLean.dot v fun i => a * S i) = a * CFDLean.dot v S
CFDLean.dot_mul.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (v S : CFDLean.Vector d) (a : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot v fun i => HMul.hMul a (S i)) (HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.dot v S))

CFDLean.physicalFlux_add.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S T : CFDLean.Vector d),
  (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => S i + T i) =
    { density := (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).density,
      momentum := fun i => (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).momentum i,
      energy := (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy + (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).energy }
CFDLean.physicalFlux_add.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S T : CFDLean.Vector d),
  Eq (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => HAdd.hAdd (S i) (T i))
    { density := HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).density,
      momentum := fun i =>
        HAdd.hAdd ((CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i) ((CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).momentum i),
      energy := HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T).energy }

CFDLean.physicalFlux_mul.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S : CFDLean.Vector d) (a : ℝ),
  (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => a * S i) =
    { density := a * (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density,
      momentum := fun i => a * (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i,
      energy := a * (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy }
CFDLean.physicalFlux_mul.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S : CFDLean.Vector d) (a : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => HMul.hMul a (S i))
    { density := HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density,
      momentum := fun i => HMul.hMul a ((CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i),
      energy := HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy }

CFDLean.physicalFlux_reverse.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S : CFDLean.Vector d),
  (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => -S i) =
    { density := -(CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density, momentum := fun i => -(CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i,
      energy := -(CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy }
CFDLean.physicalFlux_reverse.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d) (S : CFDLean.Vector d),
  Eq (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun i => Neg.neg (S i))
    { density := Neg.neg (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).density,
      momentum := fun i => Neg.neg ((CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).momentum i),
      energy := Neg.neg (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S).energy }

CFDLean.physicalFlux_zero.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U fun x => 0) = { density := 0, momentum := fun x => 0, energy := 0 }

CFDLean.pressure_toConservative.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (W : CFDLean.Primitive d),
  γ ≠ 1 → W.density ≠ 0 → CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ W) = W.pressure
CFDLean.pressure_toConservative.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (W : CFDLean.Primitive d),
  Ne γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Ne W.density (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      Eq (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ W)) W.pressure

CFDLean.primitive_admissible_toConservat.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (W : CFDLean.Primitive d),
  1 < γ → W.Admissible → CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ W)
CFDLean.primitive_admissible_toConservat.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (W : CFDLean.Primitive d),
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ → W.Admissible → CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ W)

CFDLean.primitive_roundTrip.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (W : CFDLean.Primitive d),
  γ ≠ 1 → W.density ≠ 0 → CFDLean.Conservative.toPrimitive γ (CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ W) = W
CFDLean.primitive_roundTrip.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (W : CFDLean.Primitive d),
  Ne γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Ne W.density (OfNat.ofNat 0) → Eq (CFDLean.Conservative.toPrimitive γ (CFDLean.Primitive.toConservative γ W)) W

CFDLean.squareSum_div.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (v : CFDLean.Vector d) (a : ℝ), (CFDLean.squareSum fun i => v i / a) = CFDLean.squareSum v / a ^ 2
CFDLean.squareSum_div.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (v : CFDLean.Vector d) (a : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.squareSum fun i => HDiv.hDiv (v i) a) (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum v) (HPow.hPow a (OfNat.ofNat 2)))

CFDLean.squareSum_mul.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Vector d), (CFDLean.squareSum fun i => a * v i) = a ^ 2 * CFDLean.squareSum v
CFDLean.squareSum_mul.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (a : Real) (v : CFDLean.Vector d),
  Eq (CFDLean.squareSum fun i => HMul.hMul a (v i)) (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow a (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (CFDLean.squareSum v))
